PRECAUTIONS

  • This is a hobby project, so things can go wrong. Use a spare SD card, not one with photos or anything you need.
  • Use only games you copied yourself from cartridges or discs you own. No games come with Coin Dojo.
  • Fightcade is made by other people and has its own rules. You sign in with your own account.
  • Online play: a network cable beats Wi-Fi.
  • Switch off with the power button: press it, then press it again (page 7). Don't pull the plug while a game is saving.

SETUP

STEPS 1 TO 4
1

DOWNLOAD THE IMAGE

from the project's Releases page.

2

WRITE IT TO THE CARD

with the free Raspberry Pi Imager (https://www.raspberrypi.com/software/):

  1. Pick Raspberry Pi 5, click Next.
  2. Scroll down, click Use Custom, pick the downloaded file, click Next.
  3. Put the SD card in your computer. Pick it, click Next.
  4. Click Skip customisation (settings added there stop the cabinet from starting).
  5. Click Write, then "I understand, erase and write". Wait until done.
3

START THE CABINET

Put the card in the Raspberry Pi's card slot (short edge, opposite the USB ports). Plug in a network cable if you have one, then switch on. The first start takes a few minutes.

4

JOIN WI-FI

(skip with a cable). On the game menu, move the stick until SETTINGS is in the middle, press LK. Pick WI-FI, then your network. Type its password with the stick.

COIN DOJO  -  INSTRUCTION BOOKLET- 3 -
4

SETUP

STEPS 5 TO 7
5

ADD YOUR GAMES

through the cabinet's network folder.

  • Mac: in Finder, Go, Connect to Server, type smb://coindojo.local, click Connect.
  • Windows: in File Explorer's address bar type \\coindojo.local\roms, press Enter.

Log in as coindojo, password 12345. Drag each game into its folder in roms:

  • Arcade: fbneo, arcade (MAME sets), cps1, cps2, cps3, neogeo, naomi
  • Nintendo: nes, snes (Super Nintendo), n64
  • Sega: genesis (Mega Drive), segacd, saturn, dreamcast
  • Others: psx (PlayStation), pcengine (TurboGrafx-16), atari2600

Use only games you copied ("dumped") from cartridges, discs or boards you own. Some systems also need a BIOS, a start-up file copied from the console: Neo Geo, NAOMI, Dreamcast, Sega CD, Saturn, PlayStation, PC Engine CD. BIOS files go into bios, except Neo Geo's neogeo.zip: into roms/neogeo (the folder table on page 5).

6

PLAY

On the game menu pick QUIT TO MAIN MENU, then ARCADE on the next screen (two big cards): new games show there. Leave a game with SELECT+START. Online play: FIGHTCADE (page 11).

7

CHANGE THE PASSWORD

SETTINGS, PASSWORD, CHANGE PASSWORD: type a new one twice (6 characters or more). The network folder uses it too.

ADDING GAMES

WHICH FOLDER EACH GAME GOES IN

Open the network folder (step 5, page 4), then roms. Each system has its own folder. Drag each game into its system's folder.

Arcade (MAME)arcade
Arcade (FBNeo)fbneo
CP System 1, 2, 3 (CPS)cps1 cps2 cps3
Neo Geoneogeo
Sega NAOMInaomi
Sega Dreamcastdreamcast
Atari 2600atari2600
NES / Famicomnes
Super Nintendosnes
Sega Genesis / Mega Drivegenesis
Sega CD / Mega-CDsegacd
PC Engine / TurboGrafx-16pcengine
Nintendo 64n64
PlayStationpsx
Sega Saturnsaturn

Not sure? Use the folder whose name looks closest. The game menu only shows systems that have games. Arcade games: keep the zip file as it is. Don't rename it or unzip it.

WHAT IS A BIOS?

A small start-up file copied from the console itself. Only a few systems need one. No BIOS, no problem for the others. Drag it into the folder named here (for bios/dc, make a folder named dc inside bios).

Neo Geoneogeo.ziproms/neogeo
PlayStationone scph file, e.g. scph5501.binbios
Sega Saturnsega_101.bin (Japan), mpr-17933.bin (US, Europe)bios
Sega CDbios_CD_U.bin (US), _E (Europe), _J (Japan)bios
PC Engine CD gamessyscard3.pcebios
Dreamcastdc_boot.bin and dc_flash.binbios/dc
Sega NAOMInaomi.zipbios/dc

GETTING AROUND

SHORTCUTS AND SWITCHING OFF

ON THE ROW OF SYSTEMS

STICKTurn the row of systems
LKOpen the system in the middle
STARTThe main menu (the scraper is in it, page 12)
LPTROPHIES (page 15)

IN A GAME LIST

STICKUp and down: one game. Left and right: the next system
HP / HKJump 10 games up / down
LKPlay the game
MKBack to the row of systems
MPLook at the game's pictures and video (after scraping)
SELECTOptions: sort the list, or jump to a letter

SWITCHING OFF

  1. Leave your game first: SELECT+START.
  2. Press the cabinet's power button once. SHUT DOWN? appears.
  3. Press it again within 8 seconds. Do nothing, and it cancels.
  4. Wait until the screen says NO SIGNAL. Now you can switch off at the wall.

ONLINE PLAY

FIGHTCADE ON YOUR CABINET

Fightcade lets you play arcade fighting games online against real people. It hides most of the delay, so a match with a nearby player feels like playing side by side.

  1. On the boot menu (the two big cards), pick FIGHTCADE.
  2. The first time, it downloads Fightcade. Wait a few minutes. It needs internet.
  3. Sign in with your Fightcade account. SELECT+LK opens the keyboard.
  4. Pick a game room and challenge a player.
SELECT+LKOpen the on-screen keyboard
SELECT+MKStick pointer on or off
SELECT+STARTHold 2 seconds: leave the game, back to the lobby

FULL GUIDE

Signing in, chat shortcuts and which game files work: the Online play (Fightcade) guide on the project's page. Fightcade's own help and free accounts: www.fightcade.com.

Fightcade's own game files go in the fightcade folder inside roms.

Matches never start? Your router may block them. Ask whoever set up your internet: "please turn on UPnP for my arcade cabinet".

PICTURES AND GAME INFO

SCRAPING: BOX ART, VIDEOS, RATINGS

The cabinet can fetch box art, screenshots, videos and game info by itself. This is called scraping. You need internet. A few games work without an account; for a big library, make a free ScreenScraper account (a bigger daily limit, faster). A big library takes hours.

  1. Make a free account at screenscraper.fr on your computer or phone.
  2. On the game menu, press START. The main menu opens.
  3. Pick SCRAPER.
  4. Set SCRAPE FROM to SCREENSCRAPER.
  5. Open ACCOUNT SETTINGS.
  6. Type your ScreenScraper user name (stick to move, LK to type).
  7. Type your ScreenScraper password.
  8. Make sure USE THIS ACCOUNT FOR SCREENSCRAPER is on. Press MK to go back.
  9. Open SCRAPE THESE SYSTEMS and pick your systems.
  10. Pick START at the bottom of the SCRAPER menu, and wait.

Leave the cabinet on until it says it is done. If it stops, start it again. The pictures and info stay on the cabinet. They also fill MUST PLAY and the genre lists: after scraping, pick SETTINGS, GAME LISTS, REBUILD GAME LISTS (page 14).

YOUR SCREENSCRAPER PASSWORD

The cabinet keeps it unprotected. Use a password you don't use anywhere else.

SETTINGS

PASSWORD AND GAME LISTS

PASSWORD

Every cabinet starts with the password 12345. Change it:

  1. Pick PASSWORD, then CHANGE PASSWORD.
  2. Type a new password with the stick: 6 characters or more, not 12345.
  3. Type it a second time, the same, and pick DONE.

The new password works for the login and the network folder.

GAME LISTS

MUST PLAY and the genre lists come from the ratings that scraping finds (page 12).

REBUILDREBUILD GAME LISTS: make the lists again after you add or scrape games. Then pick YES to restart the game menu.
SIZEMUST PLAY SIZE: how many games per system: 10, 15, 25 or 50.
STARSMUST PLAY GENRES MIN STARS: the lowest rating a game needs for the genre lists: 4.0, 4.5 or 5.0 stars.
COIN DOJO  -  INSTRUCTION BOOKLET- 14 -
15

SETTINGS

ATTRACT MODE, FPS, TROPHIES, TIME

ATTRACT MODE

When nobody plays for a while, the cabinet puts on a show. Any button ends it.

ON / OFFTURN ON or TURN OFF.
AFTERSTART AFTER: 5, 10, 30 or 60 minutes without play.
SHOWSHOW: VIDEO (game videos), SLIDESHOW (pictures), DIM (a darker screen) or BLACK (a blank screen).
APPLYAPPLY NOW shows up after a change: use it right away. The game menu restarts.

SHOW FPS

Shows the game's speed (frames per second) in a corner. TURN ON or TURN OFF. Leave it off for normal play.

RETROACHIEVEMENTS

Earn trophies in classic games with a free account from retroachievements.org. LOG IN with the stick keyboard, then TURN ON. HARDCORE turns off saving and loading in a game, for real bragging rights. Tap LP on the game menu to see your TROPHIES.

TIME ZONE

Pick yours from the short list, or MORE ZONES for every region and city.
